description:
Finding (2026-11-15, from a probe by the Callables session; traced by fz-engine on develop d032c7368).

Probe:
  def main() do
    pass(%{a: 1})
    pass(%{b: 2})
  end
  def pass(x), do: sink(x)
  def sink(_x), do: :ok

fz2 --log-telemetry out.jsonl run probe.fz: pass/1 has 2 keys and 6 AnalyzeActivation completions (3 per key); sink/1 has 2 keys and 2. Per key of pass/1:
1. Started by PlanEntryDispatch(pass). sink's LoweredBody does not exist yet, so the run creates no Activation(sink) and still publishes CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets at revision 1.
2. Woken by LowerFunction(sink) concluding ('current' use of LoweredBody(sink)): creates Activation(sink), summary and targets move to revision 2. This run is run 1 redone with the input run 1 lacked.
3. Woken by ReturnType(sink) concluded: expected, a caller sends its input before it reads the callee's return.
main and the main wrapper show the same three-run pattern.

Distiller (same base): 21 of 3,967 AnalyzeActivation starts are woken by LoweredBody 'current'; the big wake causes are ReturnType concluded (1,479) and ActivationInputs current (422). So the cost is mostly in small programs, where analysis outruns lowering; the fix is about running once its inputs exist, not about the distiller's instructions.

Buys: one AnalyzeActivation per caller key whose callee is lowered after the caller's first analysis (probe: 3 -> 2 per key of pass/1 and of main). Paper first: name the read that sees the missing LoweredBody, and whether the job should wait on it (as a fact wait) or the lowering should be demanded before analysis; predictions before probes. Bar: byte-identical output, no pin rises without approval; work pins that fall are lowered.

Scratch: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/fwd/ (probe, out.jsonl, dist.jsonl).

comments.text: Distiller-side size (fz-engine hunt, develop 7c94f8df2, release, distill main_returns_one): AnalyzeActivation 3,901 runs for 1,493 activations; 1,785 end blocked, 57% of its span time is in runs that ended blocked. Of the blocked runs ~470 wait on per-function static facts (FunctionContract/Recursive/InputDemand/LoweredBody/ModuleDefined), and 512 reruns woken by such a fact block again on the next one. ReturnType alone 1,312 (fz-afu.4's floor). Evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/hunt/

title: An analysis whose callee has no lowered body yet waits for it instead of running without it
